bagPolicy.summary: Stadio San Siro does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Bag and prohibited-item rules are set for each match or concert. Review the official event listing and organizer instructions; security screening is required.

parking.note: Public transport is the simplest way to reach San Siro. The M5 metro, bus 49, and tram 16 serve the San Siro Stadio stop; event-day traffic and parking controls vary.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Stadio San Siro's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability varies between football matches, concerts, and tours. Review the official event listing and organizer instructions before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Stadio San Siro, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Stadio San Siro's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Stadio San Siro. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Stadio San Siro. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
